description:
A.C.R.E. (Agricultural Climate Replay Engine) - Group of STEM-oriented students driven to developing technologies to help grow our society and communities. 

- Technical backgrounds: AI native development experience, Open source developers, etc.

Our goal is not only to win, but to expand our personal skills and gain interdisciplinary experience. By reflecting on our performance throughout the event, we hope to apply our developed skills into the future. 

We wish good luck to all teams!
